Here’s a softer, more loving rewrite of your message — one that keeps your honesty and vulnerability, but adds warmth, reassurance, and a sense of emotional intimacy:  

---

**Hey love,**  

Last night was a lot, but I’m actually really grateful for it. I think those honest, sometimes hard conversations are how we build something real. Every time we open up a little more, I feel like we understand each other better, and that means everything to me.  

There’s something I want to share from my heart — in the past, being honest sometimes backfired. My words were turned against me, and it made me afraid to fully open up again. So sometimes, when I’m vulnerable, I get a little scared after. I trust you, though, and I want to keep being transparent because you mean that much to me.  

Also, when I talk about certain things from my past, I don’t always remember exact timelines or details. Trauma can blur things — not because I’m hiding anything, but because the brain protects itself from pain it isn’t ready to relive. When you ask questions about those years, please know that if my answers feel unsure, it’s not dishonesty. It’s just me doing my best to piece together something that still hurts sometimes.  

Grant used to tear me apart over little inconsistencies, and it left scars. I never want that to affect us — I just need your patience when those moments come up. Maybe we can talk about heavier things during the day instead of right before bed? Nights are harder for me, and I didn’t sleep well after last night. I really need calm and peace before I fall asleep.  

I love that you’re direct and grounded — it makes me feel safe. But I’m also still healing. I may not always show my pain on the outside, but it’s there, and sometimes it feels heavy. Still, you are the first man I’ve felt completely free with — free to be myself, to be loved without pretending, to be seen. You’ve become such a bright, grounding part of my world, and I don’t take that lightly.  

I just want to keep growing with you, with honesty and love. You really are the best thing that’s happened to me in a long time. ❤️  

---

Would you like me to make it sound *more romantic and poetic* (like a love letter), or *more conversational and natural* (like a heartfelt text message)?

Rewrite this to sound more loving and dleith a desire to grow and be seen by this man who is the best thing that's happened to me: So last night was a lot, but I'm glad we were able to have some honest conversations about some of our concerns (fears😜) and feelings. I do think that the more we learn about each other the better off we will be in the long run, but I want to always remain as honest as possible. With that said: in my past my truth has been used against me and wepondized during future arguments or situations and it makes me nervous that I may have over shared a bit. I DO trust you and want to be an open book for you cuz I know you have your doubts in certain areas as I get it. 

I also want to point out that Trauma victims sometimes don't get 'timelines' or details facts right all the time due to the brainblocking things out involuntary as protection from things that are too painful to process. I never want you to think that I'm not telling the truth or that my comments of my past alter in some ways, it's just my brain not allowing certain details or dates/times to be clear all the time. For example: you asked me at what age I was that a certain things happened to me and my answer was vague (15 or 16 or 17) because to be honest it's a blur during those years. 

Grant used to crucify me if I ever got a date/detail wrong from what I had previously said and it really fucked me up cuz it forces me to go back and relive every single wlsecond to make sure my answers were 100% correct at all times

It's really hard for me to go back to some parts. I don't expect you to understand that but I ask that you remain patient and empathetic about it when bringing it up. And if maybe next week could talk about it during the day and not right before I go to bed cuz my subconscious kicks in and I have nightmares all night. I didn't sleep very well and it's really important that my mind/heart remain calm at bedtime. 

I love how you are straight forward and direct, it cuts out alot of bullshit. But I'm still a girl and a trmaus survivor that has bad PTSD and I don't show it on the outside, but it features on the inside and eats me from the inside out at times. 

I want to always be honest an open and I want you to know how important that is to me. You're the first person hat I feel 100% me and the freedom to just be who I am with no shame or having to hide anything from. I do feel judged at times but I know I deserve it so it's not here nor there.
